boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all five frozen records in the Confederate Heartland Offensive. Preserve per-engagement dates; the live NPS campaign heading (June-October 1862) does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen force field names armies without counts. The live NPS field reads 55000 total (US 55000; CS 0;), and the narrative says Buell's army numbered nearly 55,000 on October 7. Cist reports Buell's pre-battle 58,000 effective men, less than half in action, and Hardee's attacking divisions as some 16,000.
claims.rationale: Army totals, reported effectives and engaged fractions are different populations. Live zero is not measured absence; no figure is adopted as matched opening strength.

claims.value: Cist says Thomas, arriving with Crittenden's corps, was directed to take position on the right and wait for orders, and waited the entire day without receiving any; apart from Wagner's brigade of Wood's division, Crittenden's corps was not engaged. Only part of Gilbert's corps was engaged and McCook's corps bore the attack.
claims.rationale: Retrospective account of command use. Cist reports one brigade of Crittenden's corps engaged, so that corps was largely, not wholly, unengaged. Whether Thomas's wait without orders reflects Buell's choice, missing information or both is not adjudicated; Buell is not assigned the tactical result automatically.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads 7,407 total (US 4,211; CS 3,196); the live NPS field reads 7607 total (US 4211; CS 3396;). Cist gives Buell's reported loss as 4,348 with components 916 killed, 2,943 wounded and 189 missing, which sum to 4,048, and quotes Bragg's estimate of not less than 2,500.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. Cist's total and components do not agree in the OCR; the printed page was not checked.

open_questions: Original returns, orders, message chains, casualty reconciliation and the effective Confederate command clock remain deferred after the bounded pass. No map verification is claimed; Cist's map-label OCR is not read as evidence.
NPS/CWSAC is one family; Cist is one interested retrospective Union staff history. Quoted reports and participant accounts inside Cist are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
